title: The Maintenance tab is last; an unenrolled unit offers Enroll in Schedule
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions.
  2. An asset on no schedule and with no compliance record (open it from Customers > the customer > Assets).
custom_steps:
1. Open the asset and note which tab it opens on; read the order of the tabs.
  2. Open the Maintenance tab.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The asset opens on Work Orders; the Maintenance tab is the last tab, after Notes.
  • The tab reads "This unit is not on a maintenance schedule" with Enroll in Schedule.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10566 (S9, The asset Maintenance tab), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S9 (S9-R14, S9-R16); read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R16: “The Maintenance tab is the last tab on the asset page, after Notes. The asset still opens on Work Orders”
  • S9-R14: “An asset on no schedule shows This unit is not on a maintenance schedule, with Enroll in Schedule per S7”
